name: Anders Monsen & Unna Halsteinsdatter — marriage (1786, Norway)
researcher_question: When and where did Anders Monsen marry Unna Halsteinsdatter, and what does the marriage record show?
notes: The marriage record is real and readable directly by ark (record_read ark:/61903/1:1:NW44-PM2, collection 1468080), but as of 2026-09-16 is NOT retrievable through record_search under either persona's own indexed name -- confirmed refuted, not a ranking-tunable gap: see README 'What the live runs revealed' for the query list two independent checks (2026-09-09 and 2026-09-16/17) both missed, including the bride's exact indexed spelling with no year or collection filter across all of Norway. Digitalarkivet or another Norwegian-only archive may be the only route to f2 today. Norwegian patronymic naming (Anders Monsen = son of Mons; Unna Halsteinsdatter = daughter of Halstein) makes both names extremely common, so disambiguation rests on combining both spouses' names with the approximate 1786 date and Hordaland/Meland-area geography.
